users.title: Accounts
users.restrictedDescription: Account management is reserved for the Owner role.
users.removeConfirmNotice: The account and all its shared accesses will be removed.
users.removeConfirmDescription: Its presentations are not affected (content belongs to no one). A new sign-in with the same identity will start from scratch, with no access.

invite.title: Add an account
invite.description: The account can be given access even before its first sign-in.
invite.globalRoleDescription: Viewer suits occasional sharing: access is then given per presentation or per folder.
invite.noEmail: No email is sent: share the link yourself. The account will be activated at its first {provider} sign-in.
invite.addFailed: The account could not be added

trash.title: Trash
trash.restrictedDescription: The trash is reserved for authorized accounts.
trash.emptyDescription: Deleted folders and presentations will appear here.
trash.purgeFolderDescription: The folder and all its presentations (drafts, versions, shares) will be erased for good.
trash.purgeDeckDescription: The draft, published versions, settings and shares will be erased for good.
